g.text: All nodes and relations describe target assembly.
Hosts own persistence, output and close policy.
Model tools = framework profile + direct Agent adapters.
Skill loading never registers its business tools.
Commands use their own HTTP boundary and never enter the model list.
Skill resources disclose one business definition at a time.
CallTool uses Skill bindings; adapters use direct Agent bindings.
Runtime: eleven framework tools plus direct Agent adapters.
Cron and Child exclude the three interaction tools.
Blue relations highlight shared business execution at Java c9a2340f.
Prepared invocation, argument recovery and client presentation: Pending implementation.
Interaction tools are implemented at Java 8c5fda1d; details in the Plan Mode topic.
